title: The overdue invoice escalation ladder
content: Chases escalate by how far past due an invoice is: a reminder from 1 to 7 days, a follow-up from 8 to 21 days, and a firm note from 22 days. Each stage is sent at most once per week for a given invoice, and the ladder stops entirely after the number of chases recorded on this workflow's installation (three unless changed). Escalation changes the directness of the language and never the courtesy of it.

title: Chases are drafted for a person to send
content: The assistant drafts every chase and leaves it in the mailbox. It does not send payment reminders on its own, does not threaten action, and does not commit to terms, discounts or payment plans. Any concession is a person's decision, recorded before it is offered.
